intent: Inspect and refactor ConfiguredBoundaryProvider without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. @Component implementing SensorMetricBoundaryProvider, constructor(TelemetryProperties); preloads boundaries from TelemetryProperties.boundaries() keyed by MetricType name into SensorMetricBoundary instances; unknown/absent metric returns Optional.empty(); invalid keys fail fast at construction.
